title: Defy the Heavens
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE exceptionally clear and breathtaking cinematic LANDSCAPE xianxia cover illustration, 16:9, requested high definition 2048 x 1152. Title: DEFY THE HEAVENS.
PRIMARY USER REQUEST: a clearly readable sword cultivator SLICING THE SKIES APART; through a huge clean opening in the otherwise CLEAR BLUE SKY, the distant UNIVERSE is plainly visible.
COMPOSITION: One adult Chinese male sword cultivator on the lower RIGHT third, shown full body at three-quarter side angle, confident grounded martial stance on a mountain summit, expressive determined face turned upward toward his blade's cut. Long black hair tied loosely, elegant weathered ivory and deep-indigo Chinese robes, graceful fabric motion. Normal human scale, no giant avatar, no wings. Both anatomically correct hands hold the hilt of ONE actual straight jian sword, finishing a powerful diagonal upward slash. The blade must be long, clean and immediately recognizable, separated against pale sky; the direction of the slash follows the blade, not a random unrelated laser.
THE MAIN SPECTACLE: a SINGLE enormous crisp diagonal rift extends from near the sword tip upward through the upper-middle sky toward the upper-left. Think the blue firmament has been cleanly sliced open like a taut silk curtain: two gently curling luminous thin edges, no shattered glass debris, no chaotic cracks, no extra portals. The opening occupies about one third of the frame and is WIDE ENOUGH that the universe inside is unmistakable. Beyond its sharp boundary is deep dark interstellar space with a distant luminous spiral galaxy, layered star fields, a beautiful soft violet nebula and two or three small remote spherical worlds giving cosmic depth. Clear distinction between bright daylight OUTSIDE the rift and deep universe INSIDE it. The cut is a window into infinite space, NOT a river, aurora, cloud bank, lightning storm or a glowing path. No sun or moon mistaken for a planet outside the rift.
Outside the rift: genuinely clean azure daytime sky and only a few soft white clouds; peaceful mountain ranges and a sea of white mist far BELOW the cultivator. Simple distant Chinese mountain pavilions may be tiny scale cues. Keep background uncluttered and airy, not an army of buildings. Golden sunlight models his face and ivory silk; a restrained jade-white edge of sword intent outlines the slash, never obscuring the dark cosmic opening.
STYLE: premium smooth painterly 2D xianxia fantasy novel illustration; clean elegant contours, exquisite but selective detail, polished face and correct anatomy, beautifully drawn flowing robes, deep rich colour, controlled brushwork and luminous depth. Clearly illustrated, not photography, not 3D CGI. Dramatic epic scale while extremely visually readable. A single instant of active defiance, no tears or generic posing.
TEXT: Exact only text "DEFY THE HEAVENS", large refined cinematic ivory/antique-gold serif lettering with subtle dark contrast shadow, elegant restrained flourishes. Place at lower LEFT over a quiet darker mountain/mist pocket, one or two balanced lines, 6% safe margins, never blocking the diagonal rift, sword, face or hands. No subtitle, author, other lettering, watermark, border or interface.
Avoid: crowded composition, black storm clouds, generic lightning, exploding rock everywhere, multiple swords, detached sword beams, portals with circular frames, visible moon, malformed hands, unreadable tiny character, galaxies painted over the ordinary blue sky. Original unnamed adult cultivator in a promotional fantasy scene, not a new claim about world canon.
